lines.text: In the twelfth year, God tells Ezekiel to take up a lament for Pharaoh, a lion among the nations.
God will spread His tent over Pharaoh, a company of peoples will draw him up, and God will abandon him.
When God extinguishes Pharaoh, He will darken the stars, cover the sun with a cloud, and withhold the moon's light.
The sword of the king of Assyria will come against Pharaoh, and the most ruthless nations will destroy Egypt's hordes.
God will make Egypt a desolation so they know He is the LORD, and the nations' daughters chant a lament.
